node.title: Re: lwp authorization
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
$req->header('Authorization' => "Basic" .encode_base64('cv23gwyzqvur:ty7idfphrkl'));

I would suggest that you don't try to set your own headers, have a look at the [mod://LWP::UserAgent] docs for the credentials method instead, e.g.:

$ua->credentials("www.example.com:80", "Some Realm", "foo", "secret");

Note that if you wanted to debug this, one way would be to use [http://www.wireshark.org/|Wireshark] to capture both a successful authentication via the browser and a failed one from your script.
